display.purpose: Section headers, modal titles, major view headings. One per screen.

headline.purpose: Card titles, panel headers, major data labels.

title.purpose: Sub-panel labels, chip text, navigation items.

label.purpose: Badges, metadata, coordinate lines, overline categories.

data.purpose: All numerical instrument readouts: wind, waves, bearing, coordinates. Tabular alignment is the function.

shadows.name: glass-panel
shadows.purpose: Primary floating panel over map. Depth via backdrop-filter, not shadow.

shadows.name: popup
shadows.purpose: Map popups and modals. Highest elevation.

shadows.name: alert-glow
shadows.purpose: Orange ambient under alert banners only.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Button hover, active states. The shortest transition.

motion.name: panel-open
motion.purpose: Nav item active, panel slide. The outer limit for UI chrome transitions.

motion.name: theme-swap
motion.purpose: Full theme switch (bg + text + borders). The longest transition in the system.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.notes: Bottom nav replaces sidebar. Single column.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.notes: Full sidebar, expanded panels, wider data tables.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action. Teal in Deep Ocean, blue in Night Watch.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #008d8d; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00a5a5; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #54e0ca; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #007575; transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Subordinate actions within panels. Dark navy background.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #074873; color: #cbd5e1; padding: 8px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #085a91; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #008d8d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Primary floating container over the map. The signature component.
components.html: Wind Speed18 kt
components.css: .ds-glass-panel { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 20px; padding: 20px; } .ds-glass-inner { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-data-label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-data-value { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', monospace; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #54e0ca; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }

components.name: Dark Card (Night Watch)
components.description: Opaque card used in Night Watch mode. Flat dark with subtle border.
components.css: .ds-card-night { background: rgba(15,23,42,0.75); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 20px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-card-title { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #94a3b8; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; margin: 0 0 6px 0; } .ds-card-data { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', monospace; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: #60a5fa; margin: 0; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

components.name: Map Popup (Query)
components.description: Tap/click popup showing weather data at a map location.
components.html:
32.08°N 34.78°E
Wind14 kt
Waves0.8 m
components.css: .ds-popup { background: rgba(15,23,42,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px 16px; min-width: 170px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-popup-coords { font-size: 0.625rem; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 6px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.3px; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-popup-rows { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); padding-top: 4px; } .ds-popup-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 3px 0; } .ds-popup-label { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.6875rem; } .ds-popup-value { color: #e2e8f0; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-popup-action { width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; padding: 6px 0; background: rgba(59,130,246,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.25); border-radius: 8px; color: #60a5fa; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; } .ds-popup-action:hover { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.2); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Bottom bar / sidebar nav item. Two states: default (muted) and active (white + glass).
components.css: .ds-nav-bar { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; background: rgba(15,23,42,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-radius: 16px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-nav-item--active { color: #ffffff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-nav-item svg { flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Alert Banner
components.description: Safety warning: wind/wave threshold exceeded or hazard detected.
components.html: Strong winds forecast. Small craft advisory in effect.
components.css: .ds-alert-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #e67a32 0%, #cd8b4e 100%); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(230,122,50,0.3); color: #ffffff; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-alert-banner svg { flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Data Row
components.description: Standard weather data row inside a panel or card. Label + monospace value.
components.css: .ds-data-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-data-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-data-row__label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #94a3b8; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-data-row__value { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }

narrative.overview:
SeaYou's design language is built for a specific human being: the person who knows the difference between a 15-knot breeze and a 25-knot gale, and needs that information without ceremony. The Chart Room at Sea captures it: dense precision arranged for instant reading, every element present because it must be, nothing decorative, the ocean making the rules.

The result is a dark-dominant, high-contrast instrument interface. The three themes are not stylistic choices but environmental responses: Deep Ocean for outdoor daylight use with blue glare-resistant surfaces, Night Watch for night passages and low-light conditions in pure slate, Bright Deck for direct-sunlight operation where maximum contrast is the only acceptable answer.

Color strategy is committed: the ocean blue-teal palette carries 40-60% of every surface in Deep Ocean mode. When the scene sentence is 'sailor checking wind speed on a phone in the cockpit at 0700,' the answer is committed ocean blue, not neutral gray with a touch of teal.
keyCharacteristics: Three environment-matched themes: Deep Ocean (blue, outdoor), Night Watch (slate, night), Bright Deck (white, maximum contrast)
Glassmorphism panels are purposeful: they frame the map without obscuring it
Committed ocean palette; teal is the primary action color across all light themes
System-native typography for instrument-grade legibility at every size
Tabular data in monospace; all other content in system-ui
Functional motion only: state changes; no choreography

rules.name: The Environment Rule
rules.body: Never choose a theme based on aesthetic preference. Deep Ocean is for outdoor daylight. Night Watch is for night passages. Bright Deck is for direct sun. The theme follows the environment.

rules.name: The Teal Sovereignty Rule
rules.body: Teal (#008d8d) is the one action color in Deep Ocean mode. Reserve Aqua (#54e0ca) for data emphasis only. Two chromatic roles; no exceptions.

rules.name: The Glass Transparency Rule
rules.body: Every panel using backdrop-filter: blur() must reveal the map behind it. If a panel's background is fully opaque, remove the blur. The product is the ocean; the UI is the glass.

rules.name: The Blur-or-Nothing Rule
rules.body: A panel either uses backdrop-filter blur to reveal the map, or it uses a flat opaque background. Never a blurred background so opaque the map is invisible.

rules.name: The Bright Deck Exception
rules.body: In Bright Deck theme, all glass effects are disabled (--glass-blur: 0px). Replace with opaque white backgrounds and dark borders.

rules.name: The Monospace Gate
rules.body: If the value has a unit and is compared against other values (wind speed, wave height, bearing, coordinates), use the Data role and monospace. Everything else is system-ui.

rules.name: The Weight Cliff Rule
rules.body: Body is 400; everything above jumps to 600 or 700. No 500 weight in the hierarchy. Contrast between data and label must be legible at a glance in low-light conditions.

dos: Do use var(--app-bg-base), var(--app-bg-card), var(--app-border) and semantic tokens for every new component. Never hardcode hex directly.
Do use monospace (Data role) for all numerical instrument readouts: wind speed, wave height, bearing, coordinates, time, scores.
Do keep glassmorphism purposeful. backdrop-filter: blur() only on panels floating over the map where the map is visible behind.
Do disable glass effects in Bright Deck mode via --glass-blur: 0px and backdrop-filter: none.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion. Particle animations and theme transitions must respond to the media query.
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast on all text in all three themes.
Do use Alert Orange gradient only for genuine safety warnings.
donts: Don't build anything that looks like a generic SaaS dashboard (Linear, Notion, shadcn defaults). SeaYou is a marine instrument, not a project management tool.
Don't use consumer weather app visual patterns (Weather.com gradients, iOS weather bubbles, oversized decorative weather icons).
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. A glass panel with nothing visible behind it is just a blurry opaque box.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored stripe accent on cards, list items, or alerts.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). All text is a solid token color.
Don't add choreographed entrance animations, scroll-driven sequences, or bounce/elastic easing.
Don't hardcode hex colors for any themed surface. Use the semantic CSS custom property tokens.
Don't introduce a fourth color role to the action color system. Teal (Deep Ocean), Blue (Night Watch), Navy Blue (Bright Deck). No exceptions.
